title: Messaging Routing and Transfers: Who Answers a Text | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
When a customer texts your business, someone has to be given the conversation. This video shows how a queue of CrestApps for Orchard Core hands out conversations, with a shared pool or with routed distribution, and how an agent transfers a conversation to a colleague, with a note, or back to the queue.

In this video:
• Why routing and transfers matter
• Shared pool and routed distribution, and what happens when nobody picks a conversation up
• The inbound entry point and the Available switch
• Transferring a conversation to a person, with a note for the recipient
• Sending a conversation back to a queue
• Use cases
